extraction.NOTES: She has seven children, five of whom are now attending the boarding school; her health has improved to some extent and she has or always has had comfortable means; she has received no aid from the Government, State, or County at any time; she was not defrauded of her property and the money she received for the land was well spent and satisfactory consideration; the Indian Office denied her [some request, text unclear]; affidavit sworn before notary in May 1929 | CROSS-ROUTING PATTERN 2026-04-28: This record is one of 5 in the pine_ridge_* directory where the original Sonnet text-extraction captured a non-Pine-Ridge value in Tribe/Reservation. Pattern documented as a systematic extraction-failure mode to be aware of in the rest of the corpus.
